mapper.select: SELECT case PBC_ASSET_TYPE2 when 'T02' then (CASE ASSET_TYPE WHEN '15' THEN MNG_ORG_NAME WHEN '12' THEN MANAGER_ID WHEN '16' THEN MANAGER_ID WHEN '04' THEN FINANCIE ELSE '' END) else '' end as partyOrgName, ASSET_CODE AS assetCode, PBC_ASSET_TYPE1 AS pbcAssetType1, PBC_ASSET_TYPE2 AS pbcAssetType2, PBC_ASSET_TYPE3 AS pbcAssetType3, ASSET_TYPE2 AS assetType2, case PBC_ASSET_TYPE2 when 'R01' then RIVAL_PARTY when 'T02' then ASSET_NAME else '' end AS partyProdName FROM CHB_ASSET_INFO WHERE STATUS = 'E' AND DATE_FORMAT(IFNULL(UPDATE_TIME,CREATE_TIME),'%Y-%m-%d') = #{batchDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ( (PBC_ASSET_TYPE2 = 'R01' AND PBC_ASSET_TYPE3 IN ('L08','L09','L10','L11','L12','L13','L14','L15')) OR (PBC_ASSET_TYPE2 = 'T02' AND PBC_ASSET_TYPE3 IN ('M01','M02','M03','M04','M05','M06','M07','M08')) )

SELECT INDENTIFY_MARK AS assetCode, HOLDER_NAME AS partyProdName, HOLDER_TYPE AS partyProdType FROM PBC_TARGET_INFO WHERE DATE_FORMAT(IFNULL(UPDATE_TIME,CREATE_TIME),'%Y-%m-%d') = #{batchDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND STATUS = 'E' AND QTY > 0 GROUP BY INDENTIFY_MARK
